data.name: Thrilling Vengeance
data.description: Your savage rage thrills the crowd as you turn it upon a foe that has harmed you. When you spend a swift action to attempt a performance combat check while you're raging, you gain a +2 bonus on the check if the trigger involved you dealing damage to a creature that had hit you within the last round.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +3, rage class feature.
